description: The VKB product-package STRUCTURE standard, expressed as data so it is portable across federated VKBs and enforceable by lint_structure.py. Keyed by the OKF `type`; only `offer` is defined today. Each element declares which consumer needs it (`impact`) and whether its absence breaks that consumer (`blocking`). Linting is impact-scoped: a non-blocking gap is reported but does not fail the build or other apps. `deny` entries flag retired/forbidden artifacts.

naming.comment: Folder name == slug; lowercase, digits, dot, underscore only (e.g. make.com_for_ngos, 1password).
